name: next-up
description: Suggests up to three next prompts from your open Linear issues or GitHub issues and pull requests, after Claude finishes a turn that changed something. With no setup, it suggests continuations of the conversation instead.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Where steps come from: conversation (default), github (open issues and pull requests) or linear (your open issues). /next mode <name> changes it for one session.

linearProject.title: Linear project
linearProject.description: In linear mode, only issues in this project (name, identifier or slug). Empty: all your open issues.
